entries.1ee956583edb2309: As its basic management policy, the company says it will vigorously promote the development of new businesses and new services built on its metabolome analysis technologies and know-how, which give it a competitive advantage, and that it will raise operational excellence across its business activities in general, thereby enhancing corporate value. entries.259198da7a4126c9: A venture company originating from Keio University, founded in 2003, forming a group of two companies: the company and its U.S. sales subsidiary.
entries.26322abdf356af31: The CE-MS method is a technique that can measure ionic metabolites in living organisms simultaneously and comprehensively. The company is a university-originated venture established mainly by Professor Tomoyoshi Soga and Professor Masaru Tomita of Keio University, who developed this measurement method, and the developers of the technology are themselves part of the foundation of the business.
entries.3118a02370af04e3: This is a contract analysis service that utilizes the company's independently developed high-sensitivity comprehensive analysis technology.
entries.3b50cf1cb09e4651: This is a service that supports the development of functional materials on a one-stop basis. Through a functional component exploration package that comprehensively measures functional active ingredients contained in products, small-scale human trials, and a health claim prediction package, it supports the discovery of new functions of materials and verification of their effects. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥363 million.
